item.title: 2026 RC Chili Bowl Results
item.description: This past weekend, the largest dirt oval race of the year took place in Tulsa, Oklahoma in conjunction with the Chili Bowl, The RC Chili Bowl. Over 550 entries showed up to battle it out in the invitational and open classes.

item.title: New Hudy 1/10th Off-Road Wheel Colors
item.description: Hudy has released new 1/10th scale off-road wheel options in different colors, check it all out here.

item.title: New Team Xray 1.2mm X4'26 Hardened Spring Steel Chassis
item.description: Team Xray has released a special 1.2mm thick steel chassis made from world-renowned Hudy Spring Steel material, with unique handling characteristics and outstanding durability for the X4'26.

item.title: New VP-Pro Universal 1/8th Scale Body
item.description: VP-Pro is excited to announce their universal body shell CB-8021 for 1/8th scale buggy chassis.

item.title: New Hitec RDX4 Mini 100W AC Battery Charger
item.description: Hitec's RDX4 Mini is our latest innovation in radio control battery charging technology designed for the discerning RC enthusiasts. This compact yet powerful charger is set to revolutionize the way you power your devices.

item.title: SMJ Racing Tungsten Balance Weight
item.description: SMJ Racing has released a tungsten balance weight designed for adjusting weight distribution when using a shorty battery in electric touring cars.

item.title: New Avid RC Precision Spring Batch 2
item.description: The Avid 13mm Precision Springs Batch 2 is finally here. In addition to the restock are the (13dot | 5.05lb | Fronts) and (11dot | 3.00lb | Rears).

item.title: Adam Drake Talks Engine Maintenance [VIDEO]
item.description: This week Adam Drake took some time to talk engine maintenance including air filters, glow plugs, bearings, and clutch shoes.

item.title: 2026 US Masters of Foam Results
item.description: The 2026 US Masters of Foam was held January 16–18, 2026 at Skagit River Raceway in Washington State, USA, featuring a full weekend of competitive indoor carpet racing across six classes, and honoring the late Steve Curry.
